note: Where Laundry's design reference and its app use the same custom-property name for different things, the reference name is compared with the app property named here instead. The two are separate namespaces, not equivalent values: the app's own --accent and --space-2/4/6 keep their meaning, and the reference's declarations stay as they are. Approved by the owner, Taymoor, on 2026-10-15; the app adds the --reference-* properties as an additive adapter. See decisions.json.

map.role: The primary or signature role: #164be0 light, #2f4cf0 cobalt dark. The app's --accent stays the interactive color (#1f45ff light, #9db4ff dark), and --focus is unchanged.
The reference's 2px layout role. The app's --space-2 stays 0.5rem.
The reference's 4px layout role. The app's --space-4 stays 1rem.
The reference's 6px layout role. The app's --space-6 stays 2rem.
